penalty_summary: EUR 1,500 / 3,000 / 5,000 for a first / second / third infringement, escalating only if within three months of the previous one. No e-invoicing-specific penalties during the 1 January - 31 March 2026 tolerance period, if reasonable compliance effort can be shown.
